287
Women as offenders
Who is in prison?

101. The previous life experiences of women offenders, their reasons for offending, their
offending patterns, the impact of custodial sentences on themselves and their dependants,
and the long-term effect of prison sentences all tend to differ between men and women.

102. As at 30 June 2022, there were 3,353 women in prison, about 4% of the total prison
population in England and Wales. That proportion has remained stable for the past five
years, but in June 2022 was 18% lower than pre-pandemic levels.
288

103. On average, female offenders commit less serious offences than male offenders, often
committing non-violent, low-level but persistent offences such as shoplifting.289 They are also
overrepresented in prosecutions for specific offences, particularly non-police prosecutions.
